bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
head=4decbe64ed36b7df70e25154e48c26b93f5afc28
base=86dd6e2fb96f5632bafc18b358669e900998586a
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
oldid=sha256:44b7f6c83af3ef1d1cbba4f02caee10b39f63f6ddc2608d897a8386c2eb3a5d5
stage="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/menu-recovery-4decbe6-20261125"
tag=create-videobot:menu-recovery-4decbe6
rollback=create-videobot:rollback-menu-recovery-4decbe6
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test ! -e "$stage"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$head"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head"
mkdir -p "$stage"/{candidate,overlay}
git archive "$head" src sql test package.json | tar -xf - -C "$stage/candidate"
git diff --name-only "$base" "$head" -- src sql > "$stage/changed.txt"
test "$(wc -l < "$stage/changed.txt")" -eq 6
while IFS= read -r f; do
  mkdir -p "$stage/overlay/$(dirname "$f")"
  cp "$stage/candidate/$f" "$stage/overlay/$f"
done < "$stage/changed.txt"
# Only tracked application source in the isolated overlay: correct its file/directory modes.
find "$stage/overlay" -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +
find "$stage/overlay" -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +
find "$stage/candidate/test" -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +
find "$stage/candidate/test" -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +
docker tag "$oldid" "$rollback"
printf 'FROM %s\nCOPY overlay/src/ /opt/videobot/src/\n' "$rollback" > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$tag" "$stage" > "$stage/build.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 40 "$stage/build.log"; exit 68; }
git ls-tree -r --name-only "$head" src sql > "$stage/runtime-files.txt"
(cd "$stage/candidate"; xargs sha256sum < "$stage/runtime-files.txt") > "$stage/expected.sha"
docker run --rm -i --network none --entrypoint sh -w /opt/videobot "$tag" -c 'while IFS= read -r f; do sha256sum "$f" || exit 1; done' < "$stage/runtime-files.txt" > "$stage/actual.sha"
diff -u "$stage/expected.sha" "$stage/actual.sha"
echo ALL_SOURCE_AND_SQL_READABLE_BY_RUNTIME_USER_AND_MATCH_HEAD
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node -w /opt/videobot -v "$stage/candidate/test:/opt/videobot/test:ro" "$tag" --test test/creatorBot.test.mjs test/creatorMigrate.test.mjs test/creatorPollingStartup.test.mjs test/creatorSourceIntegration.test.mjs test/creatorUi.test.mjs test/creatorWizard.test.mjs test/creatorOwnerUpdateJobs.test.mjs test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs > "$stage/new.tap" 2>&1 || { tail -n 100 "$stage/new.tap"; exit 69; }
tail -n 15 "$stage/new.tap"
grep -F 'missing terms URL and legacy confirmation never terminate navigation or publish' "$stage/new.tap" | grep '^ok '
printf 'STAGED_IMAGE='; docker image inspect "$tag" --format '{{.Id}}'
echo MENU_RECOVERY_STAGE_TESTS_PASS_NO_DEPLOY
